result.title: Towards Spatio-Temporal Intelligence Systems in Urban Space: A Twin-Agent Perspective
result.comment: A review of urban digital twins and urban agent systems
result.summary: Cities must coordinate domains like infrastructure, mobility, environmental management, emergency response, and public services as conditions evolve. An urban Spatio-Temporal Intelligence (STI) system helps the city monitor citywide states, analyze problems, plan and execute interventions, and adapt through feedback, making urban governance more timely, effective, and transparent. Recent urban twinning and agentic AI techniques provide foundations for such systems. From a twin-agent perspective, this survey takes a system-level view of how these disparate techniques can be coherently integrated into an urban STI system. Specifically, we review how the twin reconstructs and represents a persistent, information-enriched urban environment, and how the agent understands the twin via interfaces, reasons over it, acts reliably, and continuously evolves with the city. Built upon this synthesis, we summarize a two-loop blueprint, where an inner agent loop for grounding, reasoning, and verification, and an outer system loop linking data, twin, agentic action, feedback, and update. We then use this to structure an STI research agenda and show how a shared prototype supports diverse urban domains.

AI.brief_summary: 该综述从「孪生-智能体」双视角梳理城市数字孪生与 agentic AI 如何整合为城市时空智能系统，并总结出内环（grounding、推理、验证）与外环（数据、孪生、行动、反馈、更新）的双环蓝图及研究议程。
AI.relevance_reason: 数字孪生作为持久且信息丰富的外部状态表征，以及内环「grounding–reasoning–verification」结构，可能与 LVR 中的工作区状态维持、证据获取与验证式停止决策构成类比，可供核查；但领域与任务差距较大。
